goal: Implement Reporter-only original-versus-proposed revision comparison with dev-only sample preview, read contract, and security tests
acceptance_criteria: Owned Reporter sees original vs latest real revision with changed lines, author/time/note and can switch versions including on closed reports
No revision shows honest empty state; development-only sample is visibly labeled; load failure has distinct safe state
Foreign Reporter and wrong-role direct revision reads are denied by route and RLS; code and note are inert text
Long code comparison is bounded with fallback; unit/database/lint/type/build outcomes recorded; no Developer/QA writer added
